verdict: Strong security architecture with two findings blocking mainnet deployment of specific vaults; seven high-severity findings violate documented invariants or create exploitable gaps. Audits.md ledger stale for 8 already-fixed critical/high findings.

findings.impact: EMERGENCY_ROLE pause() blocks all withdrawals — contradicts INV-3 (withdrawals never blocked). Fix exists in Vault.sol (ADR-0010) but not backported to deployed v1 RobotMoneyVault.
findings.recommendation: Backport: make RobotMoneyVault.pause() deposits-only; make withdrawalsPaused ADMIN_ROLE-only.

findings.impact: ISwapRouter.ExactInputSingleParams has 7 fields (no deadline); real SwapRouter02 on Base uses 8-field struct. Every default-V3-path call (ProtocolAssetVault, AgentTokenVault BNKR leg) would either revert or route corrupted amounts on mainnet.
findings.recommendation: Add deadline field and pass block.timestamp. Add fork test against real SwapRouter02 address.

findings.impact: Slippage floor derived from same TWAP that prices NAV — no independent backstop. Sustained manipulation across >=600s moves both mark and floor in lockstep. Basket vaults router-ineligible at HEAD limits to direct depositors.
findings.recommendation: Implement independent floor (e.g., secondary oracle, pool fee tier absolute floor). Tracked as #966.

findings.impact: RwaVault redemptions blocked when Chronicle feed stale (>24h no update). ADR-0006 §2 documents this; PRD INV-3 says 'withdrawals never blocked' — direct contradiction. Escape hatch requires two non-colluding parties. RWA is Router-eligible per PRD §11.4, compounding impact.
findings.recommendation: Resolve documentation conflict between PRD §12 INV-3 and ADR-0006 §2. Consider partial redemption returning idle USDC without oracle read.

findings.impact: RobotMoneyVault imports AccessControl without last-admin-floor guard. Sole ADMIN can renounceRole, permanently bricking all admin functions (cap changes, adapter management, unpause, restore). PortfolioRouter and Vault.sol (v2) enforce this correctly.

DeployTimelock grants ADMIN_ROLE on PortfolioRouter to TimelockController and revokes deployer, but NEVER grants ADMIN_ROLE to RouterGovernance. Governance.execute() calls router.setWeights() which reverts. All governance weight updates are bricked after handover.
findings.recommendation: Add router.grantRole(ADMIN_ROLE, address(governance)) inside _deployAndWire() before revoking deployer.

findings.impact: 8 Critical/High findings from AZ-0623 and FS-0619 audits listed as 'accepted-with-rationale' with no remediation PR, yet all 8 are code-fixed at HEAD (PRs #1084, #1093, #1098, #1099, #1092). Stale ledger misleads future reviewers.
findings.recommendation: Update docs/audits.md: change dispositions to 'fixed', populate 'Remediated by (PR)' for AZ-GW-1, AZ-BSK-1, AZ-RTR-2, AZ-BSK-2, AZ-BSK-3, AZ-BSK-5, AZ-REG-1, FS-RTR-1.

findings.impact: Timelock holds ADMIN_ROLE on PortfolioRouter. Safe (PROPOSER+EXECUTOR) can schedule operation calling router.setWeights() bypassing governance voting. Undocumented escape path.
findings.recommendation: Document as deliberate escalation path in architecture.md, or revoke ADMIN_ROLE from timelock on router.

findings.impact: IPositionAdapter missing custodiedTokens(). Vault sweepForeignToken relies on ADMIN-maintained mapping. Between addAdapter and setProtectedToken call, any caller can sweep basket token to quarantine — INV-2 violation window.
findings.recommendation: Add custodiedTokens() to IPositionAdapter and call inside addAdapter to auto-protect each token.

findings.impact: Vault emergency drain passes hardcoded 0 minUsdcOut. No vault-stored emergency floor parameter (spec assigns to #1121). Emergency drain may execute near spot price with no vault-enforced safety margin.
findings.recommendation: Implement vault-stored emergencyFloorBps (timelock-set) and pass non-zero minUsdcOut.

findings.impact: IUniswapV4Pool defines standalone-contract interface; real V4 pools live inside singleton PoolManager. Adapter cannot route swaps or read TWAP from real V4 pool. AgentTokenVault JUNO leg undeployable.
findings.recommendation: Design PoolManager wrapper contract or restrict to Base-chain-compatible V4 fork.

findings.impact: V4 adapter fork test deploys mock pool harness, not genuine PoolManager. Core functionality (TWAP, swap against real V4) never exercised in CI.
findings.recommendation: Deploy PoolManager-based test harness or defer until production V4 pool exists on Base.

findings.impact: setVaultStatus silently skips vault hook when vault.code.length == 0 (EOA/selfdestructed). registerVault does not check code length. Registry status says Retired but deposits not halted.
navDeviationGuardBps defaults to 0 (disabled) — deposits proceed regardless of spot-vs-TWAP divergence. Flash loan manipulation can inflate NAV before TWAP converges.
findings.recommendation: Set non-zero navDeviationGuardBps in deploy scripts. Add deploy-time assert for mainnet.

findings.impact: removeAsset reverts AssetStillHeld if balance > 0. No admin function sells single basket asset. Degraded pool (observe reverts) bricks totalAssets() for entire vault.
findings.recommendation: Add governance-gated adminSellAsset(index, minUsdcOut) with TWAP-derived slippage floor.

findings.impact: Formal verification CI includes vm.skip(true) on 2 of 3 SUP-1 sub-invariants. CI reports green despite zero behavior execution. Depends on #966.
findings.recommendation: Close #966 paths or revert on skip so CI is provably red until fix lands.

findings.impact: No fork test exercises BasketVault TWAP-manipulation with live pool. BasketVault.t.sol uses mock pools; TwapManipulation.t.sol is scout stub without assertion. Slot0 regression passes CI.
findings.recommendation: Add BasketVaultForkTest with real pool on forked Base asserting deposit/redeem at TWAP-bounded prices.

findings.impact: Slither configured with fail_on: high only. Medium-severity static-analysis findings pass CI silently.
findings.recommendation: Add --fail-on medium to slither config; suppress accepted mediums with dated comments.

findings.impact: MorphoAdapter.totalAssets() returns MORPHO_VAULT.convertToAssets(shares) — theoretical NAV. isExact()=true means vault trusts without margin. Bad debt in Morpho vault inflates NAV, affecting share price and router weights. maxExposure cap limits exposure but does not correct NAV.
findings.recommendation: Document upstream-venue solvency assumption. Consider per-adapter NAV discount parameter. Monitor off-chain and disable via maxExposure=0 if health degrades.

clean_areas: Custody invariants INV-1..4: well-tested, no arbitrary-recipient path exists at HEAD
Pause asymmetry on Vault.sol (v2): deposit/withdrawal split; correct in v2, known gap in v1
Gateway role separation: pairwise disjoint ADMIN/PAUSER/AGENT; last-admin floor on all five protocol contracts
Gateway window accounting: rolling-window ring buffer; nonReentrant protected; fuzz-tested for deposits
Gateway idempotency: op-kind discriminators namespace paymentIds; cross-chain replay impossible
Governance parameter isolation: snapshotQuorum captured at propose time; no retroactive effects
Router preview consistency: single shared predicate for preview and execute; divergence impossible
Router ALL-OR-REVERT: delta-balance check after each leg; donation-DoS tested
Retire/reactivate atomicity: registry enforces !routerEligible before Retired; vault hooks propagate
TWAP arithmetic (TwapTickMath): safe via Math.mulDiv; byte-identical to extracted inline code
First-deposit inflation protection: _decimalsOffset() == 18 on all vaults
Approval hygiene: forceApprove pattern on all adapters; no infinite approvals
Codehash pinning: addAsset/addAdapter verifies allowlist + codehash + identity
Watchdog SLA enforcement: zero threshold rejected at startup; pause key is PAUSER_ROLE-only
CI loud-skip discipline: fork tests revert loudly without RPC; skipped paths documented
unresolved_decisions: V4 adapter wrapper or PoolManager integration (TBD #1124) — blocks JUNO leg
MAX cap on governance votingPeriod/executionDelay (not decided)
RouterGovernance as sole setWeights caller (not enforced architecturally)
limitations: Static/source-only analysis — no fuzz or symbolic verification execution logs
Fork-test CI state at HEAD unknown — nightly red per 5f8d8cd, 2c581122
Principal checkout 20 commits behind origin/dev; PRD/architecture docs read from principal checkout
Investment Committee contract not yet shipped at HEAD
Production deployment manifest not reviewed (deployments/full-stack.json is devnet)
Watchdog pause tx uses legacy EIP-155 envelope (no EIP-1559 support)
Upstream venue risk accepted per docs (Aave, Compound, Morpho, Aerodrome, Uniswap)
